shared_ui_contract.route_contract: Each material surface resolves through the canonical Angular route/shell ownership; route guards and server authority remain separate from presentation state.
shared_ui_contract.component_contract: The catalog IMPLEMENTATION_REF is the canonical feature/shell ownership root; child components remain subordinate unless separately promoted to a MATERIAL MATRIX_ID.
shared_ui_contract.action_contract: Visible actions must map to an authoritative application/API capability and must not fabricate successful business mutations client-side.
shared_ui_contract.loading_state: Async data/action surfaces expose a non-destructive loading/busy state and prevent accidental duplicate submission while the authoritative operation is pending.
shared_ui_contract.empty_state: Collection/detail surfaces represent valid no-data/not-yet-created conditions distinctly from errors.
shared_ui_contract.error_state: Controlled failures surface reusable user feedback without leaking secrets or leaving UI state falsely committed.
shared_ui_contract.forbidden_state: Unauthorized or capability-forbidden operations are hidden/disabled or denied clearly; UI state never grants permission.
shared_ui_contract.readonly_state: Read-only contexts remain inspectable without exposing mutation controls as authoritative capability.
shared_ui_contract.responsive_contract: Layouts must reflow without horizontal overflow or inaccessible primary actions across supported desktop/laptop/tablet/mobile viewports.
shared_ui_contract.accessibility_contract: Interactive controls require semantic/keyboard-operable behavior, meaningful labels, focus-safe dialogs, and non-color-only critical feedback.
shared_ui_contract.modal_contract: Confirmation/cancellation/scanner-style interactions reuse shared dialog primitives when semantics match; no new generic duplicate modal is planned by this reconciliation.
shared_ui_contract.feedback_contract: Success/warning/error/loading/empty feedback reuses shared alert/feedback-state primitives where applicable instead of feature-local generic duplicates.
shared_ui_contract.primitive_contract: Reusable cross-feature UI behavior belongs under frontend/src/app/shared; feature-specific presentation stays inside the catalog-owned feature root.

matrix_overrides.reason: APP_SHELL owns application composition/navigation rather than a standalone feature CRUD surface; business actions remain delegated to child feature/API authorities.

notes: N8.17.E specifies the UI/UX contract for every frozen matrix root against its catalog-owned implementation root. This is reconciliation/specification only: it does not claim every child primitive is independently material, nor does it alter runtime behavior. N8.17.G must independently prove executable coverage and N8.17.H controls lifecycle promotion.
